description.value:
You transform an unoccupied @Template[type:burst|distance:10] of ground into a roiling cauldron of earth. When you Cast the Spell and the first time you Sustain it each turn on subsequent rounds, you can move the living terrain up to 15 feet in a straight line along the ground; you can't move it onto water or other liquids. Creatures in the area at any point during this movement take @Damage[4d6[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage and must attempt a Reflex save as the living terrain destabilizes the earth while moving.

Critical Success The target takes no damage.

Success The target takes half damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Clumsy]{Clumsy 1} until the beginning of your next turn.

Failure The target takes full damage, is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Prone], and is clumsy 1 until the beginning of your next turn.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage, is knocked prone, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Clumsy]{Clumsy 2} until the beginning of your next turn.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.
